name: Mateo Ramirez
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for F1 races on TV. He was particularly drawn to the engineering aspect, spending hours building model cars and tinkering with engines. After excelling in vocational school with a focus on composite materials, he landed an apprenticeship at a smaller racing team, where he honed his skills in carbon fiber repair and fabrication.

He thrives on the precision and attention to detail required in composite work, always striving for the perfect balance between strength and weight. His meticulous approach and dedication to quality have earned him a reputation as a reliable and highly skilled technician. He's known for his ability to quickly assess damage and devise effective repair strategies, minimizing downtime and keeping the car competitive.

Mateo is a firm believer in continuous learning and stays up-to-date with the latest advancements in composite technology. He is constantly looking for ways to improve his techniques and contribute to the team's overall performance. He joined Cavaleiro Sports hoping for a more challenging environment to further develop his skills.
